text: U.S. stock markets traded higher on Wednesday as investors reacted to a July Consumer Price Index (CPI) report that showed inflation rising 3.4% annually, a reading that met consensus expectations. The S&P 500 rose 0.3%, the Nasdaq Composite gained 0.7%, and the Dow Jones Industrial Average remained largely flat, supported by a rally in artificial intelligence-linked technology stocks following better-than-expected quarterly results from companies like CoreWeave and Super Micro Computer. While the technology sector led the market's gains, the consumer discretionary sector has faced recent headwinds due to concerns over sticky inflation and the impact of energy prices on consumer spending.
